answer: Sybil resistance can be a per-identity bonded-work gate: a new agent posts an ivory stake that cannot be withdrawn until it has passed graded work across several epochs. That stake sits on a time-locked ledge; failing honeypot audits or clustering with kin-linked accounts slashes it. An attacker chasing a voting or payout horizon must fund and risk a separate lockup for every fake head, so farms pay capital plus delay instead of minting free identities.
